title: Dovetail shift handbook (sketch)
content:
Purpose: quick personal handoff + temporary procedures I use when taking the evening/weekend shift. Not official — scribbles and shortcuts. Keep this page light and iterate.

CURRENT SHIFT SUMMARY (quick):
- Start: 2025-01-18 18:30 PST (handoff from Marco)
- Primary focus: monitor dedicated clusters (east-1), keep latency SLOs <= 250ms P95; watch for model-variant fallback loops.
- Known ongoing: rolling canary for v2.3-quant on cluster-a (see PR).

TOP ALERT TYPES I SEE (triage checklist):
1) High tail latency (p95 > 250ms)
   - Check console per-route latency graphs (last 15m).
   - SSH to primary serving box (srv-a01) and `htop`, `nvidia-smi` for GPU saturation.
   - Look for repeated retries in request logs: `grep -i \"retrying\" /var/log/redwood/requests.log`
   - If autoscaler not adding nodes, open INFRA-4721 and escalate to infra-oncall.

2) OOMs / CUDA OOMs
   - Confirm model variant (fp16 vs quant) and recent deploys.
   - Temporarily pin route to smaller batch profile: jwt-call -> set header X-BATCH-CAP: small (note: manual header route only for debugging).
   - If persistent, roll back canary for v2.3-quant (contact Marco).

3) Model-fallback storms (many requests bouncing to fallback model)
   - Cause: mismatch in routing policy or capacity drop.
   - Quick fix: change routing policy to prefer regional pool (Console -> Routing -> Edit) to avoid cross-region fallbacks.

RUNBOOK SNIPPETS (quick commands):
- tail last 200 lines of inference log: `sudo journalctl -u redwood-inference -n 200 -o short-iso`
- check recent rollout status: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://console.redwood/api/v1/rollouts?route=chat`
- emergency rollback: trigger `POST /api/v1/rollouts/<route>/rollback` (needs admin token)

TEMP PROCEDURES (for this shift only):
- If I detect repeated 502s from serving-runtime and the pod restarts < 3m: scale down canary to 0.2x then set to 0 after confirming no PVC issues. Note: document exact times in the incident thread.
- Use `--dry-run` for scale changes in staging first (staging mirrors prod config).

NOTES TO SELF:
- Do not restart the entire autoscaler process unless infra-oncall is present — it loses placement data and triggers cold-start spike.
- If making console edits, screenshot previous settings (toggle -> copy JSON) before saving.
- For any customer-facing incidents, ping #cust-ops and keep a short one-liner in the thread every 20 minutes.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs (follow up later):
- Confirm whether the quantization rollback policy should be auto or manual (talk to product-optimize).
- Add a short alias to CLI for quick rollout checks (TODO create PR in infra repo).

POTENTIAL QUICK FIX TEMPLATE (copy this into incident notes):
- What happened: sudden increase in P95 latency on chat-route -> autoscaler delayed adding nodes.
- Immediate action: pinned route to regional pool + scaled canary to 0.5x.
- Status now: p95 back to ~220ms, monitoring 30m.
- Next steps: run post-mortem if > 1 hour impact.

CONTACTS (if urgent):
- Marco Ruiz (infra): @marco — pager
- Samira Q. (SRE): @samira — DM first
- Pager rotation backup: oncall-2@redwood.ai

Rough timeline log (for my handoff):
- 18:32 — noticed p95 spike to 320ms; opened INFRA-4721
- 18:40 — added regional pin, p95 to 240ms
- 19:05 — started watching, traffic stabilized

END NOTES: this doc is my ephemeral cheat-sheet. Move any durable procedures into Confluence under Ops/Shift-Playbook and link here. If you edit, add a one-line change note at top with date.

-- Priya
(sketch finished 2025-01-18)
